ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast with approximately 40:60 ratio of white-to-black pixel intensity; central region is dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels, while lateral lobes feature high-intensity (white) fields.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white triangular regions on the left and right lobes; left lobe white region contains a significant yellowish-tan patch in the center; right lobe white region is narrower with black mottling encroaching from the medial and distal boundaries; solid black central column extending from peduncle to the trailing edge notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow V-shaped depression; interior angle estimated at approximately 130-140 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; peaks and valleys are most prominent on the distal portions of the lobes, with individual amplitude variations ranging from 2 to 8 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the lower leading edges; the trailing edge follows a generally linear trajectory from the distal tips to the median notch, interrupted by micro-serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters (focal spots) distributed across both white fields, particularly concentrated near the transition zones between black and white pigment.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, dark linear pixel disruption (rake mark) oriented diagonally on the right white lobe; additional smaller unaligned scratches visible near the inner boundary of the left white lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive yellowish-brown surface staining (diatom film) across the interior white regions of both lobes; evidence of tooth rake marks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetric pigmentation pattern where the central black field expands more aggressively into the right lobe than the left.
